financing.summary: Kolter Homes is the homebuilding arm of The Kolter Group, a private Delray Beach investment firm; it publishes no balance sheet, lot count, credit facility or rating. What is public shows three ways it gets lots without a land banker: (1) its sister company Kolter Land, in which Brookfield Residential bought an undisclosed ownership position in November 2024 (now trading as Brookfield Kolter Land Partners), develops master plans and delivers lots to Kolter Homes and to other builders; (2) bulk finished-homesite purchases from master developers, most visibly more than $117M paid to Landstar at Avenir since 2023, including 222 sites in August 2026; and (3) outright land buys held in 'KH' entities, such as about $75M for 446 acres in Wellington in 2025. Development money comes from EB-5 loans raised through EB5AN with a Kolter parent guaranty ($80M offering for Cresswind at Spring Haven), community development district bonds, and project-level partners and lenders at the group level (Brookfield, Carlyle, Rockpoint, BH Group, Apollo, BDT & MSD, PNC, U.S. Bank). No public tie to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found, so the opening for a land banker is the homesite takedowns Kolter now pays for in cash in bulk, and the new markets (Alabama and Texas) where it has no affiliate lot pipeline yet.
financing.land_strategy: Mixed, leaning to owning and self-developing: not land-light in the public-builder sense and no stated option target. Kolter Homes builds mostly large amenitised communities (14 Cresswind 55+ communities among 28 listed in FL, GA, NC, SC and AL as of November 2026). Lots come from the affiliated lot developer Kolter Land / Brookfield Kolter Land Partners (for example 1,300 Cresswind homes at Twin Lakes, GA and Cresswind at Hammock Oaks, FL), from bulk finished-homesite purchases inside third-party master plans (Avenir, Westlake), and from raw land bought and entitled directly (446-acre Artistry Lakes, Wellington, rezoned for 579 homes in March 2026). CEO Bobby Julien said in September 2026 that good South Florida land deals are rare and that Kolter is expanding into Alabama and Texas.

lots.note: Private company: no owned / optioned lot table is published. Public pointers only: 28 communities on the company site (November 2026); 857 Avenir homesites bought from Landstar in 2023 to 2026 (144 + 491 + 222); 446 acres at Artistry Lakes entitled for 579 homes; Twin Lakes GA planned for 1,300 Cresswind homes; Spring Haven GA planned for 700 homes. Builder 100 closings (1,606 in 2025) are in the spine.

land_banking.counterparty: Kolter Land / Brookfield Kolter Land Partners
land_banking.description: The Kolter Group's lot-development arm buys entitled raw land, develops it and sells finished lots to builders, including Kolter Homes: at Twin Lakes (Hoschton, GA) Kolter Homes is building 1,300 Cresswind homes beside D.R. Horton, Eastwood, Ryan and Fischer, and at Hammock Oaks (Lady Lake, FL) Cresswind sits beside Ryan, Meritage, Maronda and Dream Finders. This affiliate pipeline does the job a land banker would otherwise do.
land_banking.source_title: Brookfield Kolter Land Partners portfolio page: Twin Lakes
land_banking.note: Site states over $4.5 billion invested since 2008 across 90+ land projects expected to yield over 50,000 finished lots (all builders, not only Kolter Homes). Terms between Kolter Land and Kolter Homes (purchase, option or takedown schedule) are not public. Hammock Oaks builder list: https://www.kolterland.com/portfolio/hammock-oaks/

land_banking.description: Brookfield Residential's land development group acquired an ownership position in Kolter Land on 2024-11-21, forming a partnership to supply finished lots and mixed-use pads to builders in FL, TN, GA and the Carolinas. Jim Harvey, formerly President of Kolter Land, leads it. Brookfield's own site describes it as giving builders finished lots so they can keep a land-light balance sheet, with access to long-term capital.
land_banking.source_title: The Kolter Group press release, 2024-11-21: Brookfield Residential has acquired an ownership position in Kolter Land
land_banking.note: Stake size and price not disclosed. Brookfield page: https://www.brookfieldresidentialland.com/partners/kolter-land/

land_banking.counterparty: Landstar Development Group (Avenir, Palm Beach Gardens)
land_banking.description: Kolter buys finished homesites in bulk from the Avenir master developer rather than optioning them: 144 lots for $18.1M (April 2023), 491 sites for $73.6M (January 2024) and 222 sites for about $25.6M in two closings on 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19. The Real Deal puts the total above $117M.
land_banking.source_title: The Real Deal, 2026-08-20: Kolter Group drops another $26M on Avenir homesites
land_banking.note: Lot total is the sum of the three reported purchases. The January 2024 deal also gave the seller $16,620 plus 2% of proceeds per home sold (https://therealdeal.com/miami/2024/01/22/kolter-pays-74m-for-491-homesites-at-avenir-in-palm-beach-gardens/). No lender or capital partner was reported on any of the three purchases.

land_banking.description: Kolter paid $52M in 2019 for 270 acres in the Westlake master plan (western Palm Beach County), now Cresswind Palm Beach at Westlake.
land_banking.source_title: The Real Deal, 2026-08-20: Kolter Group drops another $26M on Avenir homesites
land_banking.note: Light check 2026-11-19: the source confirms $52M for 270 acres in Westlake in 2019 but does not name the seller or the month; Minto as seller and the May 2019 date are not confirmed in any source opened, and the deal is over 24 months old, so downgraded to Inferred. Community name confirmed on kolterhomes.com. Older deal, restated in the 2026 article; kept to show the pattern of bulk purchases inside third-party master plans.

land_banking.counterparty: EB5AN (EB-5 regional center and fund manager)
land_banking.description: Kolter funds community development with EB-5 immigrant-investor loans raised by EB5AN: an $80M secured loan offering for Cresswind at Spring Haven (700 homes, Newnan, GA), repayment guaranteed by a Kolter parent company, with a 4-year term per investor; an earlier EB-5 loan for Twin Lakes Georgia (1,300 homes) is closed to new investors. EB5AN says the two firms have done 25+ EB-5 projects since 2014.
land_banking.source_title: EB5AN offering page: Spring Haven (Loan with Repayment Guaranty)
land_banking.note: Not a land bank, but it is the low-cost development capital a land banker competes with. Source is the fund manager's own promotional offering page; USCIS I-956F approval letter dated 2025-08-29; $80M is the offering size, amount funded not stated.
